title: Add app-ads.txt endpoint for Google AdMob verification

requirements.summary: Serve a plain-text app-ads.txt file at the root URL path /app-ads.txt containing the Google AdMob publisher verification line
acceptanceCriteria: A file named `app-ads.txt` is placed in `frontend/public/` so it is served at the root URL path `/app-ads.txt`.
The file content is exactly: `google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0` with no extra whitespace or encoding issues.
Navigating to `https://fruitverse-kaz.caffeine.xyz/app-ads.txt` returns the correct plain-text content with HTTP 200.
The file is served with a plain-text MIME type (`text/plain`).
No other pages or routes are affected by this change.

file_operations.description: Create app-ads.txt file in frontend/public/ directory containing exactly one line: 'google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0' (without quotes). This file will be served as a static asset at the root URL path /app-ads.txt for Google AdMob publisher verification. Ensure the file has no extra whitespace, line breaks, or encoding issues that could interfere with AdMob verification.
